newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela central bank cuts discount rate to 45pct.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela central bank cuts discount rate to 45pct.

text.p: Venezuela's central bank said Thursday it dropped its discount and rediscount rate to 45 percent from 85 percent.
The bank said the new rate was effective as of October 3. The previous rate went into effect April 22.
The discount rate is the rate at which the central bank lends money to commercial banks.
The central bank added that the discount and rediscount rate in operations related to the agricultural sector would be 38.25 percent.
